settings.heading: Making Optimal Well-Being Attainable for All
settings.text: LifePharm was founded on a simple belief: health and wealth go hand in hand. We pair science-led wellness with an opportunity anyone can build on.
settings.image_alt: A smiling couple enjoying time outdoors

settings.caption: Wicky Suyanto, Founder and CEO
settings.heading: Health and Wealth, Hand in Hand
settings.text:
LifePharm Founder and CEO Wicky Suyanto grew up in Indonesia, where health was often neglected and entrepreneurial opportunities could be a challenge. He vowed to create a company where healthy living and financial independence was an achievable reality for anyone.

In 2011, he launched LifePharm with this mission.
settings.quote: I founded LifePharm on the belief that health and wealth go hand in hand: you need wealth to sustain health, and health to attain wealth. I wanted to create an opportunity where both are attainable. This is a life worth living, because life is precious.

settings.heading: Our Credo
settings.text: Three commitments that guide how we work, and who we work for.

settings.title: For Employees
settings.text: We commit to creating autonomous, diverse work environments worldwide, fostering a sense of purpose and mastery. We respect and support our employees’ health, well-being and personal responsibilities, striving to develop leaders and maintain equal opportunities.

settings.title: For Independent Business Owners and Customers
settings.text: We prioritise the trust of our Independent Business Owners and their customers, focusing on integrity in physical and financial health. Our goal is to deliver exceptional value and experiences, using advanced technology for research in longevity and well-being. We support our business owners with opportunities and education for sustainable income.

settings.title: For Communities
settings.text: We dedicate ourselves to enhancing the communities where we operate, aiming to improve health, longevity and entrepreneurial opportunities. As responsible citizens, we support local charities, care for the environment and strive to leave a positive impact on our surroundings.

settings.heading: We Think BIIG
settings.text: Balance, Integrity, Innovation and Growth sit at the centre of every action we take and every decision we make.

settings.title: Balance
settings.text: Finding a middle ground between the company’s and the customer’s needs: putting yourself in the customer’s shoes while doing what is best for the company.

settings.title: Integrity
settings.text: Being honest and trustworthy in everything we do, from the quality of the products we create to the commissions we pay out and the decisions we make.

settings.title: Innovation
settings.text: Delivering results beyond expectations for customers, managers and stakeholders, by thinking outside the box to create new ideas and simplify what exists.

settings.title: Growth
settings.text: Identifying, focusing and engaging on the strengths of our people and products. By combining our strengths, we accelerate the growth of the company.
Dr. John Ralston Davidson begins working with egg bioactive growth factors, initially focused on research for cancer patients.
Dr. Davidson passes without receiving sufficient funding. His research is thought to have died with him.
Norwegian researcher Dr. Bjodne Eskeland, later a LifePharm Emeritus Advisory Board Member, uncovers Dr. Davidson’s work and begins his own clinical studies on egg bioactive growth factors.
Dr. Eskeland publishes the first scientific paper on egg bioactive growth factors, showing a 24% reduction in cortisol, the body’s primary stress hormone.
Dr. Eskeland partners with LifePharm to refine the manufacturing process using state-of-the-art Hygienic Evaporative Cooling technology. LifePharm officially opens its doors.
LAMININE is featured on American Health Journal.
LAMININE is listed in the 2015 Physicians’ Desk Reference, putting the research directly into the hands of practising physicians.
IMMUNE+++ research is published and presented at the American College of Nutrition.
Dr. Rafael Gonzalez, a leading longevity researcher, publishes a study showing LAMININE helps support and protect telomeres, the key to slowing cellular ageing and promoting long-term health.
LAMININE is featured on Innovations in Medicine.
Dr. Alexander Hinek discovers that egg bioactive growth factors increase skin cell proliferation, collagen, elastin and fibronectin.
LAMIDERM APEX wins the Monde Selection Gold Award.
LAMIDERM APEX receives U.S. Patent No. 10,786,442 for skin regeneration. The formula is ours, and only ours.

settings.heading: Life Starts With Leadership
settings.text: The leadership at LifePharm stems from family. Wickson, Winston and Letisha joined their father at the helm of his company to help carry out his vision and drive the company forward.

settings.name: Wicky Suyanto
settings.bio: Wicky Suyanto has dedicated over 30 years as an entrepreneur in the health and wellness industry. After graduating from Pepperdine University in 1984, he began his first nutritional supplement company. He believes perseverance is the key to becoming the best. This core focus has allowed him to navigate through challenges throughout his life without giving up.

settings.name: Wickson Suyanto
settings.bio: As Vice President of Finance, Wickson's responsibility is to ensure that LifePharm sustains profitability for its IBOs. He is also responsible for the accurate and timely payments of commissions. Wickson invests in the latest financial software to continuously improve LifePharm's approach to business. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Math and Economics and a minor in Accounting from UCLA. Wickson took LifePharm from zero to 100,000 IBOs within the first two years of business.

settings.name: Winston Suyanto
settings.bio: Winston's focus at LifePharm is global expansion and working with IBOs to help their businesses succeed. With one eye on details and the other discovering new business opportunities for the company, Winston has been instrumental to LifePharm's growth from the very beginning. He holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemistry from UCLA and received his Masters in Business Administration from UCI. Winston helped open the LifePharm Opportunity in several new countries the last six years.

settings.name: Letisha Suyanto
settings.bio: With a Bachelor of Science Degree in Business Administration and a concentration in Marketing from UC Riverside, Letisha is quickly becoming an integral part of the family business. She is assisting with product development, emerging social media research and marketing. As Wicky Suyanto’s eldest daughter, Letisha has quickly followed her father’s footsteps in pursuing her passion in health and beauty.

settings.name: Kimberly Purdy Lloyd
settings.bio: Extensive and ongoing research is an absolute necessity for LifePharm. Kimberly Purdy Lloyd has a career path of formidable experience in dietary supplement and specialty skincare formulations. She joined the Dietary Supplement industry with specialties in Wound Care and Cosmetic Formulations, developing clinical and basic research protocols and peer publishes results.

settings.name: Bonnie Siddons
settings.bio: With a passion for branding and strategic marketing, Bonnie guides in shaping the messaging and visual identity of LifePharm. She brings extensive experience in brand development, content strategy, and creative direction, ensuring all marketing initiatives reflect the company’s commitment to quality, trust, and innovation. Her deep understanding of consumer engagement and storytelling enables her to craft campaigns and educational materials that empower IBOs to succeed.

settings.name: Katalin Eotvos
settings.bio: With a background in technical sciences and 15 years in multilevel marketing, Katalin has built high-performing teams and scaled networks of thousands. Since 2010, she’s led market expansion and growth strategies on the corporate side. Known for systemizing success and aligning teams under a shared vision, Katalin empowers others to replicate results and thrive in network marketing as a speaker and motivator.
